customers.json.description: Customer Fleet profiles keyed with source customer ID.

customer_vehicle_links.json.description: One record per vehicle listed on a Customer Fleet profile.

memberships.json.description: Full membership records from Renewal Membership dashboard; original field names retained.

renewal_claims.json.description: Full records from Renewal + Claims dashboard; hasClaim is a claim flag, not individual challan details.

vehicles.json.description: Unique compliance-oriented vehicle rows with insurance, PUC, fitness and tax dates / expired flags.

vehicle_portfolio_records_raw.json.description: Raw vehicle portfolio rows preserved, including duplicate source rows.

rc_statuses.json.description: RC status analysis worksheet records, including status flags.

challan_summaries.json.description: Only aggregate dashboard rows were present.

vehicle_lookup_index.json.description: Normalized registration keys map to zero-based indices in data files; raw vehicle values remain in the records.

phone_lookup_index.json.description: Digits-only phone lookup across source rows; not proof of identity by itself.

customer_name_lookup_index.json.description: Normalized name lookup; use with phone/customer ID because names can be shared.

business_partners.json.description: Unique source-specific business-partner identity tuples from membership/claim datasets.

important_limitations: No individual e-challan or court-challan records were embedded in the supplied Analytics Wall. Challan dashboard data is only monthly, state and violation aggregation.
The hasClaim field in renewal_claims.json is a claim indicator; it does not contain challan number, offence, pending amount, or payment status.
Expiry flags and dashboard bucket counts reflect the source dashboard snapshot. For accurate current status, calculate expiry from the preserved date fields against the current date at query time.
Customer names and phone numbers appear in extracted records. In production, only retrieve records after customer verification and authorization.
Index values are zero-based row indices into the corresponding JSON arrays. Vehicle registrations in records retain their source formatting; normalized keys are used only for lookup.
The included source workbooks and dashboards may represent different snapshots or source subsets. Source arrays have been preserved rather than silently deduplicated or reconciled.
